subject: sociology

moments.title: Awareness of Dying
moments.body: Their hospital study of awareness contexts in dying produces both findings and a methodological example.

moments.title: The Discovery of Grounded Theory
moments.body: Their book formalises grounded theory as an alternative to grand theory and verificationist quantitative work.
moments.takeaway: A methodology can democratise theory building.

moments.title: Glaser-Strauss split
moments.body: Strauss and Juliet Corbin develop a more proceduralised grounded theory; Glaser objects.

now.title: Grounded theory today
now.body: Constructivist grounded theory (Charmaz) and pragmatist variants dominate contemporary qualitative method teaching.
now.open_questions: How should grounded theory be combined with computational text analysis?

reflection: Glaser and Strauss made qualitative method respectable in a discipline turning quantitative.
